edits.old: This tutorial uses pydantic 1.10, so the models below follow the 1.x API.
edits.new: This tutorial uses pydantic 2.14, so the models below follow the 2.x API.

edits.old: The pin above is pydantic 1.10.13, the version this tutorial was checked against.
edits.new: The pin above is pydantic 2.14.0, the version this tutorial was checked against.

edits.old: In pydantic 1.10, a field annotated `Optional[str]` with no default is not required.
edits.new: In pydantic 2.14, a field annotated `Optional[str]` with no default is required.
edits.why: in v2 an Optional field without a default is required, not defaulted to None (a)

edits.old: Call `.dict()` on the model to get its values as a plain dict.
edits.new: Call `.model_dump()` on the model to get its values as a plain dict.

edits.old: Use `Field(regex=...)` to check the format of a slug, so only lowercase letters and dashes pass.
edits.new: Use `Field(pattern=...)` to check the format of a slug, so only lowercase letters and dashes pass.
edits.why: Field's regex argument was renamed to pattern (b)

edits.old: A model with a single unnamed field uses `__root__`, as in the next block.
edits.new: A model with a single unnamed field uses `RootModel`, as in the next block.
